grade_revision: 8 m main parapet / two photo-supported window rows before entrance-tower update

criteria.name: identity_and_source_backed_footprint
criteria.rationale: Purdue GIS FID 411 identifies BALY / Ralph and Bettye Bailey Hall; the build script creates the shell from the projected source ring.

criteria.name: position_orientation_scale_dimensions
criteria.rationale: The shell follows supplied GIS coordinates. The polygon is not a survey, and position and orientation have no independent accuracy check.

criteria.name: height_floors_roof
criteria.rationale: The official photo supports two visible window rows and a flat parapet roof. The 8 m height relies on an assumed door height, not calibrated evidence. GIS NUM_LEVELS=5 and CountOfFLO=5 remain in conflict with the photo.

criteria.name: facade_entrances_distinctive_architecture
criteria.rationale: The photo supports brick, pale trim, two visible window rows, and a recessed entrance. Exact entrance placement and the other facades were not independently established.

criteria.name: modular_export_portability_complete_evidence
criteria.rationale: Blender 5.2.3 reopened the expected single-object collection (2,928 vertices, 2,058 faces; z=0–8 m). Evidence and a fresh preview were present. The asset references project-relative brick textures.

evidence.observation: FID 411 identifies BALY and supplies the footprint ring plus NUM_LEVELS=5 and CountOfFLO=5 attributes.
Documents the official Purdue photo, its two visible window rows, brick and limestone details, flat roof silhouette, and limitations.
Uses the GIS ring for the shell; sets HEIGHT_M=8.0 as a photo-scaled estimate and models two window rows.
Reopened in Blender 5.2.3 LTS with expected object and collection; one object, 2,928 vertices, 2,058 faces, z=0–8 m.
Shows the two-row brick facade and flat roof form.

findings: The 8 m height remains unsupported by measured or calibrated evidence; GIS five-level attributes conflict with two visible photo rows.
The official photo shows only part of the building, leaving entrance placement and remaining facade layout incompletely checked.
The model revision was improved, but the evidence remained below the 8/10 threshold.
evaluator_implementation: Reviewer independently scored each rubric criterion against the sources, build script, preview, and fresh Blender reopen, then summed the criterion points.
